text:
Opened your business six months ago? You can still beat the guy who's been around since 2009.

Google ranks local businesses on how well you match the search, how close you are and how well known you are.

Years in business is nowhere on that list.

Electrician in Ellenbrook. Open since 2010. Last Google review: 2021.

New sparky nearby asks every customer for a review.

Google's map ranking counts your reviews and your rating.

So the new sparky climbs past the 2010 one. Ask for reviews every week, however long you've been open.

Google moved many Search campaigns to AI Max on 1 September. AI Max picks extra searches for your ads.

Plumber in Midland? Open your search terms report.

Seeing "how to fix a leaking tap"? You paid for a DIYer's click.

Block that search with a negative keyword.
